name: Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet
oracle_text:
Lifelink
If a nontoken creature an opponent controls would die, instead exile that card and create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
{2}{B}, Sacrifice another Vampire or Zombie: Put two +1/+1 counters on Kalitas.
blocked_sentences: If a nontoken creature an opponent controls would die, instead exile that card and create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

needs.what: a static replacement of a creature dying (battlefield to graveyard only), filtered by the dying permanent's controller and token-ness (nontoken, controlled by an opponent), that sends the card to exile instead AND performs an additional effect for the static's controller as part of the replacement -- here create_token zombie_2_2_b under Kalitas's controller. The creature does not die, so no dies/creature_dies trigger may be used to make the token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The static replace_graveyard (Rest in Peace / Leyline of the Void) redirects every card or token going to a graveyard from anywhere, keyed by affects_player, with no 'from battlefield only' scope, no nontoken-creature filter and no rider effect to create a token; replace_leaves_battlefield / replace_deaths are one-shot ops on chosen objects, not a standing static; a creature_dies trigger cannot fire because the replaced event is not a death
